tasks.title: Centralize Prompt Cache in Engine
tasks.description: Move prompt file caching into an engine module with documented keys/invalidation and hit/miss logging; keep `buildPrompt` pure.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt cache reads/writes occur only in `src/engine` and `buildPrompt` no longer manages caching.
Cache keys and invalidation rules are documented in the new module and tests cover hit/miss behavior.
Cache usage is logged with hit/miss metrics and includes `sessionId`, `phase`, and `component`.

tasks.title: Add TUI Rendering Integration Test
tasks.description: Create an integration test that renders TUI views using mocked engine state and verifies render output without invoking business logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Test uses mocked `TuiEngineData`/events and does not execute agents or build prompts.
Render output includes expected labels/sections for the mocked state.
